# Historical upstream binaries

Any upstream binaries retained locally in this directory predate the 1.1.2 security changes.
The publication snapshot intentionally excludes them; it contains source only.
Do not install them as a hardened build. Build the source and use
`addin/ArcGISProMCP/bin/Release/ArcGISProMCP.esriAddinX`.
See `../SECURITY.md` and `../docs/security-review-2026-09-28.md`.
